statements: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.global_seq (value BIGINT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO kogwistar.global_seq(value) SELECT 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kogwistar.global_seq)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.user_seq (user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value BIGINT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.index_jobs ( job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, namespace TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', entity_kind TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL, index_kind TEXT NOT NULL, coalesce_key TEXT NOT NULL, op TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, lease_until TIMESTAMPTZ NULL, retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT NULL, payload_json TEXT NULL, next_run_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL, max_retries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_index_jobs_status_lease ON kogwistar.index_jobs(status, lease_until)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_index_jobs_status_next_run ON kogwistar.index_jobs(status, next_run_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_index_jobs_entity ON kogwistar.index_jobs(entity_kind, entity_id, index_kind)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_index_jobs_namespace ON kogwistar.index_jobs(namespace)
ALTER TABLE kogwistar.index_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS namespace TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE kogwistar.index_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS coalesce_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
ALTER TABLE kogwistar.index_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS next_run_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL
ALTER TABLE kogwistar.index_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS max_retries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10
ALTER TABLE kogwistar.index_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS claim_token TEXT NULL
ALTER TABLE kogwistar.index_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS claim_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_index_jobs_pending_ns_ck ON kogwistar.index_jobs(namespace, coalesce_key) WHERE status='PENDING'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.index_applied_state ( namespace TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', coalesce_key TEXT NOT NULL, applied_fingerprint TEXT NULL, applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), last_job_id TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(namespace, coalesce_key) )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_index_applied_state_key ON kogwistar.index_applied_state(coalesce_key)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.projected_lane_messages ( message_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, namespace TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', purpose TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user_visible', inbox_id TEXT NOT NULL, conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL, sender_id TEXT NOT NULL, msg_type TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, seq BIGINT NOT NULL, conversation_seq BIGINT NOT NULL, claimed_by TEXT NULL, lease_until TIMESTAMPTZ NULL, retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, available_at BIGINT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NULL, step_id TEXT NULL, correlation_id TEXT NULL, payload_json TEXT NULL, error_json TEXT NULL, prev_message_id TEXT NULL, next_message_id TEXT NULL, inbox_tail_message_id TEXT NULL, conversation_tail_message_id TEXT NULL )
ALTER TABLE kogwistar.projected_lane_messages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS purpose TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user_visible'
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lane_messages_namespace_inbox_seq ON kogwistar.projected_lane_messages(namespace, inbox_id, seq)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lane_messages_claim ON kogwistar.projected_lane_messages(namespace, inbox_id, status, available_at, lease_until)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lane_messages_conversation_seq ON kogwistar.projected_lane_messages(namespace, conversation_id, conversation_seq)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.namespace_seq ( namespace TEXT PRIMARY KEY, next_seq BIGINT NOT NULL )
INSERT INTO kogwistar.namespace_seq(namespace, next_seq) VALUES ('default', 1) ON CONFLICT(namespace) DO NOTHING

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.entity_events ( namespace TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', seq BIGINT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL, entity_kind TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL, op TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), PRIMARY KEY(namespace, seq), UNIQUE(event_id) )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_entity_events_aggregate ON kogwistar.entity_events(namespace, entity_kind, entity_id, seq)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.replay_cursors ( namespace TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', consumer TEXT NOT NULL, last_seq BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), PRIMARY KEY(namespace, consumer) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.named_projections ( namespace TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, last_authoritative_seq BIGINT NOT NULL, last_materialized_seq BIGINT NOT NULL, projection_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, materialization_status TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(namespace, key) )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_named_projections_namespace ON kogwistar.named_projections(namespace, updated_at_ms)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.workflow_design_snapshots ( workflow_id TEXT NOT NULL, version BIGINT NOT NULL, seq BIGINT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(workflow_id, version) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.workflow_design_version_deltas ( workflow_id TEXT NOT NULL, version BIGINT NOT NULL, prev_version BIGINT NOT NULL, target_seq BIGINT NOT NULL, forward_json TEXT NOT NULL, inverse_json TEXT NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(workflow_id, version) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.server_runs ( run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, workflow_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NULL, user_turn_node_id TEXT NULL, assistant_turn_node_id TEXT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, result_json TEXT NULL, error_json TEXT NULL, created_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, started_at_ms BIGINT NULL, finished_at_ms BIGINT NULL )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kogwistar.server_run_events ( seq BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, event_type TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_server_runs_status ON kogwistar.server_runs(status, updated_at_ms)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_server_run_events_run_seq ON kogwistar.server_run_events(run_id, seq)
